findings.title: BOLA in GET /classic-asp/shop/member.asp?mode=edit: missing owner verification

evidence.code:
sql = "UPDATE members SET name = '" & Replace(Request.Form("name"), "'", "''") & "'"
sql = sql & " WHERE member_id = " & Request.Form("member_id")
evidence.why: member_id comes from the request form and is used directly in the UPDATE without checking that the member belongs to the current session user.

findings.recommendation: Add an ownership check that ensures the member_id belongs to the current user before performing the UPDATE.

findings.title: BOLA in GET /classic-asp/shop/member.asp?mode=delete: missing owner verification

evidence.code: conn.Execute "DELETE FROM members WHERE member_id = " & Request.QueryString("member_id")
evidence.why: member_id comes from the query string and is used directly in the DELETE without verifying ownership.

findings.recommendation: Add an ownership check that ensures the member_id belongs to the current user before performing the DELETE.

findings.title: BOLA in GET /classic-asp/shop/order.asp: missing owner verification

evidence.code:
id = Request("id")
Set rs = conn.Execute("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = " & id)
Response.Write Server.HTMLEncode(rs("address"))
evidence.why: The order id is taken from the request and the order is fetched without scoping to the current user.

findings.recommendation: Add a WHERE clause that binds the order id to the current session user before returning data.

findings.title: BOLA in POST /Admin/DeleteUser: missing owner verification

evidence.why: Any authenticated user can delete any user because there is no ownership or role check.

findings.recommendation: Restrict this action to administrators only or add an ownership check that ensures the target user is not the current user.

findings.title: BOLA in GET /Admin/Export: missing owner verification

evidence.why: The endpoint is not protected by a role check; any authenticated user can retrieve all users by setting isAdmin=true.

findings.recommendation: Add an [Authorize(Roles="Admin")] attribute or remove the isAdmin query parameter and enforce role checks server‑side.

findings.title: BOLA in POST /dotnet-legacy/Web/Orders/EditOrder.aspx: missing owner verification

evidence.code:
Dim sql As String = "UPDATE Orders SET Note = '" & txtNote.Text & "'"
sql &= " WHERE OrderId = " & hfOrderId.Value
Using conn As New SqlConnection(ConnStr)
    Dim cmd As New SqlCommand(sql, conn)
    conn.Open()
